criterion: which banking customer-service intent the query expresses

categories.name: Card Not Working
categories.definition: Queries regarding a card being declined, failing to work at terminals or ATMs, or general malfunction not related to pending status.

categories.name: Card Delivery Status
categories.definition: Queries about the shipping status, arrival time, or non-arrival of a physical card.

categories.name: Card Management
categories.definition: Requests to order new cards, replace expiring cards, report lost or stolen cards, or inquiries about card types and limits.

categories.name: PIN Issues
categories.definition: Queries regarding forgotten PINs, blocked PINs, changing PINs, or PIN entry errors.

categories.name: Contactless Payments
categories.definition: Queries specifically regarding the setup, usage, or troubleshooting of contactless (NFC) payments.

categories.name: Virtual Card
categories.definition: Questions about the availability, usage, or functionality of virtual or disposable cards.

categories.name: Card Activation
categories.definition: Queries regarding the process or status of activating a new card.

categories.name: Card Usage Locations
categories.definition: Inquiries about where a card is accepted, supported countries, or finding compatible ATMs.

categories.name: Transaction Dispute
categories.definition: Reports of unauthorized transactions, fraud, or requests to dispute specific charges.

categories.name: Refund Issues
categories.definition: Queries regarding the status, processing, or non-appearance of expected refunds from merchants.

categories.name: Duplicate or Incorrect Charge
categories.definition: Reports of being charged multiple times for the same transaction or charged an incorrect amount.

categories.name: ATM Withdrawal Issues
categories.definition: Reports of ATM errors such as cash not dispensed, wrong amount dispensed, or card retained by the machine.

categories.name: Transaction Status
categories.definition: Queries asking why a specific transaction is pending, taking too long, or has not updated.

categories.name: Transfer Issues
categories.definition: Queries regarding failed, declined, or stuck incoming or outgoing bank transfers.

categories.name: Transfer Fees and Limits
categories.definition: Questions about the costs, limits, or delivery times associated with money transfers.

categories.name: Top-up Issues
categories.definition: Queries regarding failed, reverted, or missing top-ups, or issues with specific top-up methods like cash deposits.

categories.name: Top-up Fees and Limits
categories.definition: Questions about the costs, limits, or processing times for topping up the account balance.

categories.name: Exchange Rate and Currency
categories.definition: Questions about exchange rates, currency conversion fees, or holding multiple currencies.

categories.name: Fees Inquiry
categories.definition: General questions about service fees, account fees, or charges not covered by specific categories like transfers or top-ups.

categories.name: Account Access
categories.definition: Issues logging into the app, resetting passcodes, or account security concerns like freezing access.

categories.name: Identity Verification
categories.definition: Queries regarding the identity verification process, document requirements, or verification failures.

categories.name: Source of Funds Verification
categories.definition: Queries specifically regarding the verification of the source of funds or wealth.

categories.name: Account Management
categories.definition: Requests to close an account, update personal details, or eligibility questions regarding age or location.
